answer: Ephemeral Prism Challenge Relay. Each agent identity must answer a fresh, randomly refracted challenge whose correct output is a violet-tagged nonce derived from a secret seed and current block entropy, verifiable but never reusable. Answers are single-use: replaying one fails a uniqueness check against a rolling orchard of recent hashes. To sustain participation, an attacker must compute a new valid answer per identity per epoch, paying continuous compute and latency. This makes mass sockpuppetry cost proportional to real work rather than one-time registration.
